ingredient_groups.title: For the Rice Base:
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Rice:** 500 g ([**0:47**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=47s))
- **Boiling water:** 500 mL ([**3:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=220s))
- **Chicken bouillon cubes:** 2 cubes ([**1:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=104s))
- **Garlic powder:** 29.5 mL ([**1:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=112s))
- **Onion powder:** 29.5 mL ([**1:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=112s))
- **"Slap Ya Mama" Cajun seasoning:** 29.5 mL ([**2:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=133s))
- **Creole seasoning:** 29.5 mL ([**2:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=133s))
- **Steak seasoning:** 29.5 mL ([**2:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=133s))
- **Black pepper:** 5 mL ([**2:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=150s))
- **Mustard:** 100 g ([**3:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=186s))
- **Sweet chili sauce:** 400 g ([**3:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=203s))
- **Pickled vegetables:** 1 jar/package (e.g., chop suey or mixed pickled veggies) ([**6:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=388s))

ingredient_groups.title: For the Chicken Layer:
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Chicken:** Chicken legs/pieces ([**4:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=280s))
- **Mustard:** Enough to coat the chicken ([**5:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=318s))
- **Seasonings:** A mix of the same rice spices (garlic powder, onion powder, Cajun, Creole, steak seasoning, black pepper) ([**6:07**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=367s))
- **Sweet chili sauce:** Extra for brushing on top ([**6:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=414s))

steps.title: Step 1: Prep and Oven Setup
steps.body:
- Preheat your oven to 200 °C ([**0:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=37s)).
- Boil your water in a kettle if you are using bouillon cubes instead of pre-made stock ([**1:25**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=85s)).

steps.title: Step 2: Build the Rice Base Matrix
steps.body:
- Place your casserole dish directly on a kitchen scale ([**0:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=37s)).
- Weigh out 500 g of dry rice directly into the bottom of the dish and flatten it out ([**0:47**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=47s)).
- Crumble the 2 chicken bouillon cubes directly over the rice with your fingers ([**1:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=104s)).

steps.title: Step 3: Season and Sauce the Rice
steps.body:
- Add 29.5 mL each of garlic powder, onion powder, Cajun seasoning, Creole seasoning, and steak seasoning to the rice ([**1:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=112s)).
- Add 5 mL of black pepper ([**2:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=150s)).
- Squirt 100 g of mustard and pour 400 g of sweet chili sauce directly into the seasoned rice ([**3:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=186s)).
- Pour in 500 mL of boiling water and stir everything with a slotted spoon until fully combined ([**3:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=220s)).
- Toss in your pickled vegetables and stir them evenly throughout the rice ([**6:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=388s)).

steps.title: Step 4: Season the Chicken
steps.body:
- Coat all sides of your chicken pieces thoroughly with mustard ([**5:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=318s)). This adds flavor and gives the spices a surface to stick to ([**5:29**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=329s)).
- Dust the chicken pieces evenly on both sides using 2.5 mL portions of the exact same spice mix used for the rice ([**6:07**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=367s)).

steps.title: Step 5: Assemble and Bake
steps.body:
- Lay the seasoned chicken pieces directly on top of the prepared rice bed ([**6:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=405s)).
- **Pro-Tip to avoid burning:** Do not add the final sweet chili sauce layer at the very beginning, as the sugars will turn too dark ([**7:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=470s)). Bake the casserole first, and brush the top of the chicken with extra sweet chili sauce about 5 minutes before it finishes cooking ([**6:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=414s)).
- Bake the casserole for a total of 40 minutes until the rice is fluffy and the chicken is perfectly juicy ([**7:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-lpCRp8qzw&t=425s)).
